title: Singapore's Prime Minister Wong Explains Why Alice Wong Was Released After Nvidia Chip Probe
author: Xebec
text:
S

soAsian
Well-known member

Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong has defended his country's handling of investigations into the alleged diversion of Nvidia AI chips to China, amid growing scrutiny over Singapore's role in the US-China technology rivalry.

Addressing questions about Singapore-based company Megaspeed and Alice Wong, Lawrence Wong insists that Singapore does not enforce US export controls but will not allow its companies or territory to be used as a channel to circumvent American restrictions. He confirms that investigations into Megaspeed are ongoing, while Alice Wong was released after authorities found insufficient grounds for further prosecution.

Wong also reveals that Singapore has requested additional information from US authorities to verify documentation and identify the end users of the Nvidia chips, some of which were reportedly routed through Singapore to other countries without entering the country. He maintains that Singapore will take firm action against any company found violating its own laws.

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese also addresses the allegations, describing them as serious while stressing that Australia is not directly involved in the matter. The exchange highlights the growing geopolitical stakes surrounding advanced AI chips, export controls and the competition between Washington and Beijing

This is interesting. Singapore's PM said Nvidia chip bought by Megaspeed never enter Singapore.
